# Release notes

The newest release is first. In Odoo the version number starts with the Odoo version, so release 1.1.0 for Odoo 20.0 shows as `20.0.1.1.0`.

## 1.0.17

*2026-11-07, Odoo 17.0 - 20.0*

- Schedules tab on each store: how often orders are checked and stock and prices are sent, the last run of each, and Run Now buttons.
- Alerts tab: chosen users get a note and a "Failed store jobs" activity when a job fails after its retries; the log can keep only warnings and errors.
- Tips and import duties as their own order lines (Tip and Duties products), so totals match Shopify.
- Order source (Online Store, Point of Sale, Draft Order, apps), Store Pickup and the Shopify order tags on the sales order.
- Shopify POS orders: delivered from the warehouse of their shop location, an optional walk-in customer, and an option to leave them out.
- Local pickup: a Ready for Pickup button tells Shopify the order is ready, and Shopify sends the customer its pickup message.
- Import new orders by shipping status (all, not shipped yet, or shipped).
- Products: Import Collections, products put in the manual collection of their Odoo category (optionally created), Odoo tags sent as Shopify tags, keep selling when out of stock (store default and per product), and taxable from the Odoo taxes.
- Sales channels: publish the products Odoo sends on the channels you tick, for example Online Store and Point of Sale.
- Webhooks for product changes and deletions, and for new customers.
- Payouts: an account per transaction type for disputes, reserves, adjustments, Shopify bills and more.
- Orders tab: shipping policy, lock confirmed orders (store changes and cancellations still apply), a customer receivable account per store, invoice and payment on the store order date, and the store order number as payment reference.
- Shipping methods can set an Odoo delivery method (carrier) on the order and its delivery; the shipping price stays the store's.
- Store Text tab on a store product: a title and description sent to this store only.
- Commerce Bridge 1.0.23: update Commerce Bridge as well. It now needs Odoo's Delivery app, which is installed with the update.

## 1.0.4

*2026-11-05, Odoo 13.0 - 20.0*

- Platform badge on imported sales orders: WooCommerce, Shopify or Amazon in the platform colour, next to the order number, with the store name when you have several stores.
- Order number: name orders after the store number (as before) or let Odoo number them; the store number stays on the order and under the badge.
- Payment methods have separate settings for unpaid orders (cash on delivery, bank transfer): confirm, validate the delivery, and invoice when completed, at import or never.
- Taxes: new choice to use the store taxes and then apply the fiscal position; tax accounts for the taxes the store creates; tax rate decimals to match rates like 15.0199% to 15.02%.
- Shopify fraud analysis on the order (risk level, recommendation and reasons), a Fraud Risk filter, and an option to hold risky orders as quotations.
- Custom items and gift cards import on their own products (custom item, custom item shipped, gift card) instead of stopping the order.
- The store setting Confirm Unpaid Orders moved to each payment method (Unpaid: Confirm); your current choice is kept when you update.
- Commerce Bridge 1.0.10: update Commerce Bridge as well.

## 1.0.3

*2026-11-05, Odoo 13.0 - 16.0*

- Now available for Odoo 13.0, 14.0, 15.0 and 16.0, with the same features as on Odoo 17.0 - 20.0 (Commerce Bridge 1.0.9). On Odoo 13.0 the payout entry moves the payments from the payment journal's account to the bank, as Odoo 13.0 has no outstanding payment accounts.

## 1.0.3

*2026-11-05, Odoo 17.0 - 20.0*

- New store dashboard: one card per store with orders and sales of the last 7 days, a daily chart, Queued and Failed Jobs tiles, the last sync time and Sync Orders, More and Open Store buttons.
- Several stores per company: the same Shopify shop cannot be connected twice in one company, so orders are never imported twice.
- Imported orders keep the date the customer ordered. Before, confirming the order in Odoo set the order date to the import time (Commerce Bridge 1.0.9: update Commerce Bridge as well).

## 1.0.2

*2026-11-04, Odoo 17.0 - 20.0*

- App description update only: the app's website link on the Odoo Apps Store opens this user guide, and the guide address is shown on the page.

## 1.0.1

*2026-11-04, Odoo 17.0 - 20.0*

- The app is now listed as Odoo Shopify Connector.
- Commerce Bridge 1.0.3: clearer notes in the Sync wizard; the delivery setting is now called Send Deliveries to the Store.

## 1.0.0

*2026-11-04, Odoo 17.0 - 20.0*

- First release, on the Shopify GraphQL Admin API (2026-10).
- Orders with taxes, discounts and shipping, cash on delivery and other pending payments, refunds and cancellations from Shopify, with webhooks and a 15-minute check.
- Stock per Shopify location, prices with compare-at prices, fixed prices for Shopify Markets, fulfillments with tracking, cancellations and credit notes from Odoo.
- Products and variants in both directions, with images.
- Shopify Payments payouts as journal entries matched with the order payments.
- Needs Commerce Bridge 1.0.2.
